user.title: Junior Baby Log
user.description: Stores entries synced from the Junior iOS app. Babies and their sensors appear automatically once the app syncs.

upsert.name: Upsert records
upsert.description: Write record versions by id (last write wins on modified_at). Older versions are kept in history and reported as stale. A record with deleted_at set is a soft delete.

records.name: Records
records.description: List of records: id, baby_id, kind, started_at, ended_at, wet, pooped, left_breast, right_breast, amount_ml, amount_confirmed, comment, modified_at, deleted_at.

babies.name: Babies
babies.description: Optional list of babies (id and name) to register or rename.

delete.name: Delete records
delete.description: Soft delete records by id. Nothing is removed; the previous version stays in history.

deleted_at.name: Deleted at
deleted_at.description: When it was deleted (also its modified_at). Defaults to now.

list.name: List records
list.description: Return current record versions (soft-deleted ones included) changed since a time, for reconciliation.

since.name: Since
since.description: Only records modified / deleted after this time.

summary.name: Summary
summary.description: Return only id, modified_at and deleted_at per record.

export.name: Export backup
export.description: Return one baby's records as a Junior iOS backup file.

baby_id.name: Baby ID
baby_id.description: Required when there is more than one baby.

include_deleted.name: Include deleted
include_deleted.description: Also export soft-deleted entries (with deletedAt). Current app versions would import them as live.

import.name: Import backup
import.description: Import a Junior iOS backup file for one baby.

backup.name: Backup
backup.description: Contents of the backup JSON file.

baby_id.name: Baby ID
baby_id.description: Defaults to the file's baby, or the only known baby.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: merge adds only unknown ids; replace makes HA match the file: changed entries get a new version, the baby's entries missing from the file are soft-deleted.

stats.name: Statistics
stats.description: Per-day totals, timeline segments and a summary for a date range, computed from the stored records (powers the Junior panel).

start.name: Start
start.description: First day (local). Defaults to so the range ends today.

pair.title: Pair a phone
pair.description:
Scan this code with the iPhone camera to open Junior and pair it, or copy the link into Junior → Settings → Home Assistant.

The link only allows syncing the baby log, but treat it like a password.

Link: `{link}`

Sync URL: `{url}`

import_backup.title: Import backup
import_backup.description: Upload a Junior backup file (from the app's Backup → Save backup file…, or from this integration's export).

data_description.baby: Which baby the entries belong to. "From the file" uses the baby recorded in the file, or the only baby if there is just one. You can also type a new baby id.
data_description.mode: Nothing is ever erased: replace soft-deletes this baby's entries that aren't in the file.

reset_pairing.title: Reset pairing
reset_pairing.description: Creates a new pairing link. Every paired phone stops syncing until it's paired again with the new code.

abort.imported: Imported into {baby}: {imported} added, {updated} updated, {unchanged} unchanged, {skipped} skipped, {deleted} soft-deleted.
abort.paired: Done. The phone syncs within a few seconds of pairing.
abort.pairing_reset: Pairing reset. Pair your phones again with the new code.

options.merge: Merge — add entries that aren't in Home Assistant yet
options.replace: Replace — make this baby match the file
